claims.text: A Royal Court statement datelined Jeddah 26 Rajab 1433 / 16 June 2012 says King Abdullah mourns Prince Nayef bin Abdulaziz, Crown Prince, Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Interior, who died that day, Saturday 26/7/1433 AH, outside the Kingdom. The funeral prayer is set for after Maghrib on Sunday 27/7/1433 AH at the Grand Mosque in Makkah.
claims.locator: Dateline; Royal Court statement; trailer (filed 13:29 Makkah time)
claims.uncertainty: No hour or place of death is given beyond outside the Kingdom. He is styled Crown Prince at his death, so this statement is the evidence for the end of his crown-princeship.
